verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch explicitly markets team collaboration ("Helps you collaborate across your teams to design, develop, and test APIs faster"), supports team search in workspaces, and applies shared headers/auth at the collection level, implying a synced team workspace exists. However, there's no detailed documentation of how workspace sync actually works, and community feedback flags gaps like single-workspace limitations offline and no self-host login in desktop app, plus a request for git-based collection sync suggesting current sharing/versioning is imperfect. Missing for 10: detailed docs on real-time sync mechanics, conflict resolution, and independent hands-on verification of team workspace sharing at scale.
